fluid.yaml:
mesh: ../poisson/cube.msh
output: ../../results/fluid/transient.vtu
fluid:
  mode: transient
  dt: 0.05
  steps: 10
  ramp_time: 0.1
  density: 1
  viscosity: 1
  pressure_drop: 1
solver:
  relative_tolerance: 1.e-10
  absolute_tolerance: 1.e-12
  maximum_iterations: 30

elastic.yaml:
mesh: cube.msh
output: ../../results/fsi/elastic.vtu
fsi:
  body: elastic
  dt: 0.02
  steps: 10
  pressure: 1
  density: 1
  viscosity: 1
  young: 100
  poisson: 0.3
  solid_density: 1
  thickness: 0.25
solver:
  relative_tolerance: 1.e-10
  absolute_tolerance: 1.e-12
  maximum_iterations: 20
